Tina (support): Hey team — customer A reported a spike in tool-invoke errors for their payment webhook integration. Seeing lots of 400s when the model returns tool args. stack trace + sample request below.

Maya Chen: thanks, can you paste the raw request they sent and the error id?

Tina (support): error_id=err_2026_7b9, curl:

Tina (support): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4x","input":"refund ticket","tools":[{"name":"payment-refund","schema":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"}}}],"tool_call":{"name":"payment-refund","arguments":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}}}'
```

Tina (support): The tool invocation was rejected by our gateway: `400 malformed_args: amount expected number`

Jordan Patel: ah — tool args arrived as strings. Did the model suddenly change output formatting? Any recent eval/golden prompt pushes?

Jourdan (eval): We merged a change to the function-calling golden prompt suite yesterday that added randomized argument quoting to catch brittle parsers. It might have shifted evals, but shouldn't hit prod unless rollout happened. I will check the CI -> can you confirm if the customer is on Dedicated?

Tina (support): Dedicated customer, vpc-123, pinned to rwd-4x@v2. No recent customer-side config changes.

Eli Rivera: grabbing logs from the routing layer now. Jordan — do we have parsing code that coerces types at runtime? I recall a small change in the tool-selection handler last week.

Jordan Patel: type coercion was supposed to be idempotent, but we removed a fallback in commit 9f8a2b — that could stop auto-casting strings to numbers. If the model returns stringified numbers, validators will fail now.

SRE-Bot: Alert: increased 5xx rate for payment-refund service between 2026-05-12T14:25 and 14:38 UTC, peak 4.2% errors.

Maya Chen: Ok action plan: 1) get a reproducible request that fails locally, 2) confirm if parser change is deployed to Dedicated infra, 3) short-term: add tolerant coercion in gateway as hotfix. Who can reproduce?

Tina (support): I reproduced locally with the provided curl, got same `malformed_args`. Posting minimal repro payload:```{
  "tool_call":{"name":"payment-refund","arguments":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}}
}```

Eli Rivera: repro confirmed. Minimal fix: accept numeric strings for numeric fields for one release. I'll open a PR for a server-side tolerant parse in the gateway with a feature flag.

Jourdan (eval): Also rolling back the randomized quoting in the golden prompt CI while we investigate, to avoid further regressions sneaking through. I'll pin the golden prompt to last-known-good and re-run the toolsuite.

Jordan Patel: Good. We should also add a schema-suite test that fuzzes quoted vs unquoted numbers so future merges fail CI instead of reaching prod. Jourdan, can you add a test to the toolcall-regression suite?

Jourdan (eval): On it. Adding a small test matrix: number as number, number as string, null, missing. Will add to CI gate.

Maya Chen: ETA on hotfix? We need it to protect customers until we release proper parser changes.

Eli Rivera: I'll put up a hotfix PR in 15m, request reviewers. If approved, we can ship a scoped gateway change to Dedicated fleet by rolling patch.

Tina (support): Customer notified: "We've identified the issue and are rolling a temporary fix; will follow up with root cause and timeline." They asked if billing will be impacted. No billing spikes reported.

Jordan Patel: After hotfix, we should run an end-to-end test with the customer's exact payload and our smoke harness (embedding -> tool choice -> invocation) to confirm no other transformations are happening.

Jourdan (eval): I will run the smoke harness against a staging copy of their Dedicated config and post results here.

DeployBot: Deploy queued: gateway/hotfix-allow-numeric-strings -> staged -> dedicated-pools.

SRE-Bot: Note: monitor latency during rollout, autoscaler may scale up due to spike in retries.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updated with PR links and CI run IDs. We'll convert to a postmortem if it reaches customer-impact threshold.

Tina (support): PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/842

Eli Rivera: PR opened, requesting review from @jordan @maya. Patch adds try-coerce-for-numeric to gateway args validator behind feature flag.

Jourdan (eval): CI run for golden-suite rollback: https://ci.redwood.ai/alg/9764 — one flaky test failed but unrelated. E2E against customer's payload passed after hotfix staged.

Tina (support): Customer confirmed recovery, errors dropped to 0. Closing loop, will draft incident summary.

Maya Chen: Add follow-ups: (a) permanent parser fix, (b) add schema fuzz tests to CI, (c) improve eval gating to prevent randomized golden changes from auto-promote.

Jordan Patel: I'll own (a). Jourdan owns (b/c).

Tina (support): Thanks team :thumbsup:
